title: Durable effect activation ingress with recovery embargo
description: Objective: land the missing daemon/store production consumer for the four-leg execution claim and @moe/runner effect.activate, and fence both with persisted recovery state before any execution authority is allocated. Deliverable: a focused daemon activation service that reads current persisted restore/project embargo state, composes the existing claimWork and activateEffect production surfaces, commits attempt/slot/lease/effect/spend atomically only after all gates pass, and is reached from production daemon ingress. MEASURED GAP at HEAD c0c5929: runWorkClaimCommand only records board-work ownership, claimWork (lease+slot+budget+effect intent) has no daemon production caller, activateEffect has no daemon production caller, and therefore the coordinator's required zero-attempt/slot/lease/effect/spend assertion would be vacuous. Existing ACTIVE recovery binding alone does not prove reconciliation complete; project QUIESCED/recoveryRequired state is durable. Consumer: task-cf7fb147bd1c47698cbd65c9535370aa. NOT in scope: collecting inventory, class vocabulary, quarantine decisions, external process launch, or recovery.complete. Owned paths: focused daemon work/effect activation service, persisted recovery embargo reader, minimal command-registry wiring, and focused tests; split daemon-store-dependencies.ts before growing it beyond 400. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test && pnpm --filter @moe/runner test.
definitionOfDone: A production daemon command/service—not a test harness—invokes the existing claimWork four-leg gate and @moe/runner activateEffect, and exposes an accepted path that atomically records attempt, slot, lease, effect and budget/spend authority.

Before claimWork or activateEffect runs, the service reads persisted selected-restore and exact project recovery state; QUIESCED/recoveryRequired, missing, unreadable, or mismatched state returns RECOVERY_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED at layer RECOVERY_INVENTORY.

A recovery embargo refusal creates zero attempt, slot, lease, effect, activation grant or spend rows/events, while release/drain operations required to reduce old authority remain available; tests include a positive control proving the same production path creates the records when unembargoed.

Structural/malformed activation still returns its existing upstream code/layer before recovery binding comparison where specified, while a well-formed embargoed request preserves RECOVERY_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED/RECOVERY_INVENTORY without flattening.
Replay and concurrency tests prove one accepted activation and zero duplicate authority, and every refusal assertion pins exact code, stage/layer and event/decision counts.

A mutation drill bypasses the production embargo comparison and turns the named daemon ingress test red; fresh pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test && pnpm --filter @moe/runner test exits 0.
taskRails: Do not treat board work.claim ledger ownership as execution authority; the positive path must compose the four-leg claimWork and activateEffect surfaces.
Do not accept caller-selected recovery state or infer completion from an ACTIVE binding alone; use selected restore plus durable project recovery state.
Embargo must precede every authority allocation and commit, yet must not prevent safe release/drain of existing authority.
Tests assert exact stable reason code/layer and prove non-vacuous zero-authority with a positive production control.
Target <=250 physical lines per production source and split before 400; split daemon-store-dependencies.ts before adding lines.

Cases, each asserting the EXACT triple {code:"RECOVERY_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED", layer:"RECOVERY_INVENTORY", cause:<distinct>} — not merely `!ok`: (1) CLEAR: restore ABSENT + project READY & recoveryRequired false -> ok:true; (2) CLEAR: restore INSTALLED + project READY & recoveryRequired false -> ok:true (reconciliation completed); (3) cause PROJECT_RECOVERY_REQUIRED: project lifecycle QUIESCED (this is the task-rail-2 case — an INSTALLED/ACTIVE restore binding present but project still QUIESCED must NOT clear); (4) cause PROJECT_STATE_ABSENT: no project decision in the ledger at all; (5) cause PROJECT_STATE_UNREADABLE: state present but lifecycle outside RUNTIME_LIFECYCLES.PROJECT or recoveryRequired not boolean; (6) cause PROJECT_STATE_MISMATCHED: `recoveryRequired !== (lifecycle === "QUIESCED")`, and separately state.projectId !== the queried projectId; (7) cause RESTORE_UNREADABLE: `readInstalledRestore` refuses — drive it by installing a binding whose decoded record refs disagree with the binding refs (readInstalledRestore returns controllerRefusal RESTORE_RECORD_UNREADABLE) — assert the upstream {layer, code} is carried verbatim in an `upstream` field and NOT flattened. implementationPlan.description: Ingress vocabulary and envelope decode. Create apps/daemon/src/activation/activation-ingress-contracts.ts (target <=150 lines) + its .js bridge. Also export `decodeActivationRequestBytes(input: unknown)` mirroring decodeWorkClaimRequestBytes in ./work/work-claim-contracts.js: it validates ONLY the envelope (bytes decode, schemaVersion, kind, commandId/correlationId/principalId/projectId/decidedAt shapes, and that payload's own keys are exactly EFFECT_ACTIVATE_PAYLOAD_KEYS) and returns {ok:false, code:"ACTIVATION_INGRESS_REQUEST_MALFORMED"} otherwise. implementationPlan.note: activation-ingress-contracts.ts (186 lines) + .js bridge. Exports EFFECT_ACTIVATE_COMMAND_KIND ("effect.activate", pinned `satisfies RuntimeCommandKind` so a kind outside the contracts vocabulary fails to compile), ACTIVATION_INGRESS_SCHEMA_VERSION "moe-effect-activate/1", sorted EFFECT_ACTIVATE_PAYLOAD_KEYS, ACTIVATION_SECTION_KEYS (deliberately WITHOUT "intent" — the intent is server-derived, so no call site can forward one), closed ACTIVATION_INGRESS_CODES, ACTIVATION_INGRESS_LAYER = DAEMON_INGRESS, ActivationIngressOutcome structurally identical to WorkClaimOutcome (decisionOf takes it unchanged), activationIngressRefusal, and decodeActivationRequestBytes. The decoder validates the ENVELOPE ONLY — bytes, exact 9-key request set, kind, schemaVersion, id/instant/expectedVersion shapes, and that payload's own key set is exactly the 6 sections — and inspects no domain content of any section, so a well-formed embargoed request cannot be answered by a domain code. pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck: exit 0.

implementationPlan.description: RED — ingress service tests. Create apps/daemon/src/activation/activation-ingress.test.ts against the not-yet-written `runEffectActivateCommand`. Build ONE coherent request fixture in-file: reuse the hand-written four-leg payload shape from ./work/work-claim.test.ts (budget/effect/lease/liveClaims/slot with intent state PENDING version 0) and the activation half modelled on ../recovery/recovery-test-fixtures.ts — attempt {state:"LAUNCH_REQUESTED"}, claim, leaseProof matching the intent's leaseBinding on leaseToken/epoch/authorityHashRef/ownerSessionRef with expectedVersion === lease.version, tombstone null, wrapperIdentity, lockIdentity, observedGraphEpoch === intent.expectedGraphEpoch, desiredState === intent.desiredState, dependencyWitnesses, observedRuntimeDigest === intent.runtimeObservationDigest. NEVER hand-forge a grant: parseActivationGrant needs hex64 and a digest-derived grantId and canonicalDigest is not exported (mem:gotcha-coherent-activation-fixture-needs-activateeffect); the record must come out of the production chain. Do NOT reuse activation-ledger-fixtures.ts — its GRANT_ID "grant-0001" is codec-legal but parser-illegal. Cases: (1) POSITIVE CONTROL, unembargoed: one accepted call; assert ok, disposition DECIDED, and read the durable aggregate back with `readActivationLedgerRecord(deriveActivationAggregateId(intent.aggregateId, intent.idempotencyKey), store.readEvents(...))` asserting providerSlot.state==="ACTIVE" with attemptRef bound, budgetReservation.state==="ACTIVATED", effectIntent.state==="ACTIVE", attempt.state==="RUNNING", grant.state==="UNUSED", lease present, and effectIntent.version===predecessorIntentVersion+1 && attempt.version===predecessorAttemptVersion+1. (2) EMBARGO ZERO-AUTHORITY: quiesce the project via runRestoreQuiesce, re-run the SAME request, assert code RECOVERY_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED and refusedBy/layer RECOVERY_INVENTORY, then assert store.readEvents(derived aggregate) length === 0 AND that the total committed decision count for the project is unchanged versus a snapshot taken before the call — count-based, so no attempt/slot/lease/effect/grant/spend row or event was created. (3) RELEASE STAYS OPEN under the same embargo: `runWorkClaimCommand(store, <work.release bytes>)` still returns ok — embargo fences allocation, not drain. (4) PRECEDENCE, both directions: a structurally broken ENVELOPE under embargo returns ACTIVATION_INGRESS_REQUEST_MALFORMED / DAEMON_INGRESS (structural wins); a well-formed envelope with a domain-broken four-leg payload under embargo returns RECOVERY_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED / RECOVERY_INVENTORY, NOT flattened and NOT the WORK_* code; unembargoed, that same domain-broken payload returns its verbatim upstream WORK_* code at layer AUTHORITY. (5) REPLAY: same commandId+identical bytes twice unembargoed -> second is ok with disposition REPLAYED, event count still exactly 1, and the returned record digest equals the first (the replay is answered from durable bytes, not echoed). (6) CONCURRENCY: two DISTINCT commandIds targeting the same (aggregateId, idempotencyKey) -> exactly one ok, the other refuses ACTIVATION_LEDGER_EXPECTED_VERSION_CONFLICT at layer ACTIVATION_LEDGER, and the aggregate still holds exactly one event. (7) A second activation reusing the same grantId under a different aggregate refuses ACTIVATION_LEDGER_GRANT_ID_CONFLICT. Every refusal assertion pins code AND layer AND the event/decision counts — never bare `!ok`. Record the suite RED.

GREEN — the activation ingress service. Create apps/daemon/src/activation/activation-ingress.ts (target <=250 lines, split before 400) + its .js bridge. Export `runEffectActivateCommand(store: SqliteEventStore, input: unknown): ActivationIngressOutcome` running these stages in EXACTLY this order (the boundary confirmed with the human this session): (A) `decodeActivationRequestBytes(input)` — refuse ACTIVATION_INGRESS_REQUEST_MALFORMED / DAEMON_INGRESS; (B) `readActivationEmbargo(store, request.projectId)` — refuse RECOVERY_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED / RECOVERY_INVENTORY, preserving `cause` and `upstream` unflattened. NOTHING below runs until the embargo clears; (C) `claimWork({budget, effect, lease, liveClaims, slot})` from ../work/work-claim.js — on refusal surface its WorkFailure code and layer VERBATIM; (D) `applyEffectCommand(successors.effectIntent, {kind:"arm"})` from @moe/runner — CLAIMED->ARMED; surface EFFECT_* code and layer verbatim; keep `armed.version` as predecessorIntentVersion; (E) `activateEffect({intent: armed, ...request.payload.activation})` — the intent is SERVER-DERIVED from (D) and must never be taken from the caller payload; surface SupervisorFailure code/layer verbatim; keep request attempt.version as predecessorAttemptVersion; (F) `activateProviderSlot(successors.providerSlot, {dimension: successors.providerSlot.dimension, slotRef: successors.providerSlot.slotRef, requestId: successors.providerSlot.requestId, attemptRef: commit.attempt.attemptId})` from @moe/scheduler — the sole RESERVED->ACTIVE transition; NEVER spread `{...slot, state:"ACTIVE"}`; (G) `activateReservation(successors.budgetView, successors.budgetReservation, {expectedVersion: successors.budgetReservation.version, attemptRef: commit.attempt.attemptId})` — yields state ACTIVATED, moves no units; both command fields are server-derived, not caller-supplied; (H) assemble the ActivationLedgerRecord with recordVersion ACTIVATION_LEDGER_RECORD_VERSION, lease/budgetView from (C) — budgetView is reserveForAdmission's own post-reservation view, never recomputed — providerSlot from (F), budgetReservation from (G), effectIntent/attempt/grant/activationDigest/activationVersion from (E)'s commit, and the two predecessor versions from (D)/(E); (I) `commitActivationLedgerRecord(store, {correlationId, decidedAt, key: {commandId, principalId, projectId}, record, requestBytes})` — one atomic store decision that writes attempt, slot, lease, effect, grant and spend authority together or not at all; surface ACTIVATION_LEDGER_* code at layer ACTIVATION_LEDGER verbatim, never flattened into a generic code. On success map the CommandDecisionResponse into the accepted outcome shape. All step-4 cases go green.
